description:
Configures Single-sign On App Extension instead of Platform SSO. The SSO app extension provides SSO to apps, websites, and accounts that use Microsoft Entra ID for authentication. Creates an Microsoft Entra ID registered object.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/intune-service/configuration/use-enterprise-sso-plug-in-ios-ipados-macos?pivots=macos#sso-app-extension
name: POC_MAC_D_COPE_SSO_AppExtension
